calls.title: Susan and Ashley
calls.summary: Susanne Keenan, a candidate with a strong marketing leadership background in enterprise technology and cybersecurity, discussed her proven track record in scaling teams and revenue. She highlighted her experiences at companies like Talon and Algolia, where she led substantial team and revenue growth, alongside her expertise in demand generation and content strategy at Cisco and Lancope. Susanne emphasized her hands-on operational skills and knowledge of tools like Six Sense and SEO software, and she reflected on her experiences in startup environments. Additionally, she analyzed Growth Book's current marketing context, which relies on branded traffic and seeks to enhance account insights and lead capture. Susanne plans to present her strategic priorities for the first year, aligning her vision with current marketing needs.
calls.keywords: enterprise marketing, demand generation, cybersecurity marketing, account-based marketing, AI chatbot, SixSense
